about: Roshanak Abri Kuzegar's sketchbook, the Red Dominion (traveller's image, Phase 3; docs/pencilled/red-dominion.md). Keys follow her sketch numbers.
style: Black ink drawing on white paper in a travel sketchbook, monochrome pen and ink only, no colour at all, shading done only with hatching and cross-hatching, confident loose linework, unfinished edges fading into blank paper. No text, no lettering, no handwriting, no numbers, no signature.

scenes.s1-point: A walled stone town on a rocky headland at the tip of a long coast, seen from a ship at sea: thick walls running down into the water, a harbour enclosed inside the walls with masts in it, stone houses climbing the rock above.
scenes.s2-ship-town: A small coastal town seen from the deck of a ship offshore across calm water. Along a curving pebble shore stand about forty low stone cottages, and every cottage roof is a whole wooden boat turned upside down, a rounded planked hull with the keel running along the top. In the middle of the town stands a long low stone hall whose whole roof is one big ship's hull lying upside down, like an overturned boat on a beach: keel uppermost along the ridge, the curved planked hull sloping down to the walls on both sides, bow and stern at the two ends, no deck visible, no masts or railings on it. A wooden quay, two masts in the harbour, low hills behind. A ship's rail across the near foreground.
scenes.s3-harbour-master: A harbour-master's house seen close: a low stone-walled cottage roofed with an upturned wooden ship's hull, the keel running along the top as the ridge-beam, curved ribs showing at the gable end as rafters, the hull planks overlapping like clapboard. A door is cut through the side of the hull, framed by an old square patch of planks kept around the doorway. A rain barrel and a coil of rope beside it.
scenes.s4-figurehead: A baker's shop in a stone wall under a roof made from an upturned boat hull. Over the door, mounted on the wall like a sign, a carved ship's figurehead of a woman holding an armful of fish, painted white. Loaves on a board in the window; three people waiting at the door.
scenes.s5-bell: A ship's bronze bell hanging in a frame of old ship timbers in a small stone-paved town square, a rope hanging from the clapper. Around the square, houses roofed with upturned boat hulls.
scenes.s7-mountains: Evening, from the deck of a ship close to a long low coast: far inland a dark line of mountains under heavy cloud, the near shore flat, the ship's rigging and rail in the foreground.
